## 原页视觉核验范围

### `gr-qc/0102107v2`

- PDF p.5 / printed p.5：MSS 的 `P,T,m,s,f,g`，`T` 为 elapsed-time real interval，位置与 force 以 `t∈T` 给出；
- PDF p.7 / printed p.7：Theorem 5，time definable from remaining MSS primitives；
- PDF p.8 / printed p.8：proof uses domains depending on `T`；Theorem 6 says P7 autonomous; authors explicitly contrast prediction/future with a phase-space description of physical state.

### `math-ph/0104032v1`

- PDF p.8 / printed p.8：Theorem 2 says time dispensable in Gurtin--Williams continuum thermodynamics; Definition 11 makes time a domain component; Definition 12 recovers it as the last component/domain of listed functions; Definition 13 gives the no-explicit-time restatement;
- PDF p.9 / printed p.9：authors call the resulting picture insufficiently operational and say time remains useful for practical purposes; they classify eliminability as a logical consequence of the foundations.

## Boundary for C0R8

These sources give a published/author-primary route from a domain-dependent formal representation to a stated operational caveat. They do **not** by themselves:

1. identify ZFC rather than a generic set-theoretic model as the actual foundation `M` of the cited paper;
2. define a Zeno/round-trip `Q`, a formal `OriginDone`, or a `FormalDone → OriginDone` bridge;
3. prove that their no-explicit-time formulations lose all temporal structure (the papers explicitly recover time from function domains/components);
4. establish a mathematical-community policy, bare-ZFC defect, or object-language inconsistency.
